summary_ko.description: A concise Korean interpretation, at most two sentences.

work_items.description: Distinct current tasks. Merge chronological reports about the same task and keep the latest reported state.

description_ko.description: Concise Korean task description without copying a source quote.

referenced_issue_url.description: Explicit referenced issue URL, otherwise null.

state.description: Latest state reported by the supplied excerpts, not independent verification.

modality.description: Conditional takes precedence when a prerequisite controls the work.

condition_ko.description: Korean prerequisite when modality is conditional, otherwise null.

assignee_login.description: Only an explicitly assigned or clearly self-assigned login; authorship or completion alone is insufficient.

effort_mentions.description: Every explicit duration once, separate from work items so shared effort is not duplicated.

work_item_indices.description: Referenced work_items indices; empty only for whole_thread or unknown scope.

whole_thread_completion_reported.description: True only for a clear report that the entire current issue is complete; null when scope is uncertain.

relation_target_url.description: Explicit related issue URL, resolving a bare number against the current repository; otherwise null.

clarification_reason_ko.description: Concise Korean reason when ambiguity prevents a definite interpretation.
